Kestrel Lane Bikes

Workshop repairs for road, gravel and town bikes, in a small workshop behind the station. Book a service slot, drop the bike off before work and collect it the same evening.

Wheel builds

Hand-built wheel sets laced to your rims and hubs, trued and tensioned on the stand, with a second check after the first hundred kilometres.

Bike fitting

Fitting sessions take ninety minutes and end with a written report of every change made to saddle, bars and cleats.
